data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'modestus', meaning 'honest' or 'humble'. In Christian tradition, Modestine is a name symbolizing virtuous and humble living. The name Modestine carries the meaning “Honest, humble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Modestine usually hope their child will grow to embody honest, humble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
